headline: Edwards Drops 45 as Acuff Bricks
subhead: Acinonyx won the night 10-1 while theInfamous rode Darius Acuff Jr. and his 5 for 24 into a 9-2 hole.

zingers.line: Darius Acuff Jr. went 5 for 24 and 0 for 7 from three, and theInfamous now trails 9-2.
Gopher Gold dropped Brook Lopez, watched him post 17 and 11 off the wire, and got five players on the floor.
Down 10-1 to Acinonyx, Zero Fox Given got 3 for 13 from Rui Hachimura and a big zero from Nic Claxton.
Josh Giddey went 1 for 10 for two points, and White Mambas trail Nova Knicks 8-3.
Nova Knicks started Coby White for a line of zeros and watched Caleb Wilson commit nine turnovers.
MONSTARS ☄️ left Isaiah Jackson's 13 points on the bench and only lead Suggs to be you 7-4.
Cameron Boozer went 2 for 15 and De'Anthony Melton scored zero, so LeParth James cut Melton before breakfast.

night: Anthony Edwards hung 45 points, 10 rebounds and 9 threes on 16 for 29 shooting for BrookynDynasty.
Darius Acuff Jr. went 5 for 24 and 0 for 7 from three for theInfamous, the worst brick of the night.
MONSTARS ☄️ left Isaiah Jackson on the bench for 13 points that never counted.
Keaton Wagler put up 15 points and 3 threes on 4 for 8 and is still sitting on the wire, unclaimed.
Acinonyx won the night 10-1 over Zero Fox Given behind Yves Missi's 13 points, 14 rebounds and 3 blocks.
